name: Healthcare, Food Safety & Sanitation Department
description: Regulates retail food establishments, mobile culinary trucks, institutional sanitary licensing, health inspections, water sanitation, and vector control.

operating_hours.weekdays: Monday – Thursday: 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM; Friday: 8:00 AM – 1:00 PM
operating_hours.weekends: Closed (24/7 Foodborne Illness Emergency Line Active)

submission_channels.name: Health Pavilion Counter 7
submission_channels.details: Present completed form, ServSafe certifications, and equipment spec sheets in person.

submission_channels.name: Direct Health Intake Dispatch
submission_channels.details: Submit scanned PDF packet to health-licensing@pixelvyne.gov with subject [NEW APPLICATION].

standard_processing_time: 3 to 7 business days prior to scheduling pre-opening site inspection
